spcsm_2024.title: SEER Program Coding and Staging Manual 2024

summary_stage_2018.title: SEER Summary Stage 2018 (v3.3)
summary_stage_2018.effective_note: Published November 2025; effective for all cases diagnosed 2018-01-01 and forward. publication_date records edition recency for precedence; unit-level applies_to.dx_date_min carries the 2018 effective date.

store_2024.title: STORE 2024 (CoC Standards for Oncology Registry Entry)
store_2024.effective_note: 2024 edition; each compiled item carries its own effective date on applies_to.dx_date_min (the item's NAACCR implementation year). publication_date records edition recency for precedence only.

seer_rsa_eod.title: SEER*RSA EOD Public 3.3
seer_rsa_eod.effective_note: Edition recency for precedence only, not an effective date. Every unit carries its own applies_to.dx_date_min (the algorithm's effective year, or the schema-selection table's year_dx range when it states one).

seer_rsa_tnm.title: SEER*RSA TNM 2.1
seer_rsa_tnm.effective_note: Edition recency for precedence only, not an effective date. Every unit carries its own applies_to.dx_date_min (the algorithm's effective year, or the schema-selection table's year_dx range when it states one).
